title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria requires correct identification of conservation laws violated for each decay process.

title: Correct Laws
description: Important Criteria includes accurate conservation laws related to angular momentum, lepton number, baryon number, energy, and electric charge.

title: Clarity of Explanation

title: Specificity

title: Common Errors
